whispers-in-may-2026.title: Whispers in May
whispers-in-may-2026.c: Netherlands / Sweden / South Korea / Hong Kong, China
whispers-in-may-2026.syn: Fourteen-year-old Qihuo travels through the Liangshan Mountains with two friends to find a skirt for her coming-of-age ceremony. The quest makes room for play and conversation just before adulthood asserts itself.
whispers-in-may-2026.bio: Chen Dongnan made Singing in the Wilderness, about a Miao choir in Yunnan. Her second feature develops the places where documentary work and collective invention can overlap.
whispers-in-may-2026.st:
Produced by Jia Zhao, the film premiered at CPH:DOX and won its top prize. IDFA describes how the journey was developed with the girls, who improvised within places and relationships that were familiar to them.

The film won the Youth Jury Award at Pingyao and has circulated through both nonfiction and feature-film programmes.
whispers-in-may-2026.editorial: The skirt gives the expedition a direction. Notice what the girls decide to share along the way and how their decisions give the filmmaking its rhythm.
highlights: A Yi changing-skirt ceremony sets the journey in motion.
The girls helped develop the trip and improvised scenes.
Winner of the main CPH:DOX prize.
honors: 获奖｜2026 CPH:DOX · DOX:AWARD
入选｜2026 Visions du Réel
获奖｜2026 Pingyao International Film Festival · Youth Jury Award
入选｜2026 8th Hainan Island International Film Festival · Asian Horizon
whispers-in-may-2026.contentNote: Public story information includes bereavement, puberty, social expectations around adulthood. Detailed depiction and audiovisual intensity await verification.

9-temples-to-heaven-2026.title: 9 Temples to Heaven
9-temples-to-heaven-2026.c: Thailand / Norway / France / Singapore / China / Hong Kong, China / Indonesia
9-temples-to-heaven-2026.syn: After a fortune teller predicts his elderly mother's death, Sakol takes three generations of his family on a nine-temple pilgrimage. They have one day to complete it, and each stop reveals something about their hopes and frictions.
9-temples-to-heaven-2026.bio: Sompot Chidgasornpongse studied at CalArts and worked as assistant director on Apichatpong Weerasethakul's Tropical Malady, Syndromes and a Century, Cemetery of Splendour and Memoria. This is his fiction feature debut following Railway Sleepers.
9-temples-to-heaven-2026.st: Drawn from the director's experience, the film was produced with Apichatpong and shot by Jonathan Ricquebourg. A fixed pilgrimage schedule creates a framework in which small disagreements, delays and jokes can accumulate.
9-temples-to-heaven-2026.editorial: Watch who keeps the group moving and who is usually left waiting. The pauses between temple visits give the family ensemble much of its humour and tenderness.
highlights: Nine temples structure a multi-generation road movie.
A fiction debut produced with Apichatpong.
World premiere in Directors' Fortnight.
honors: 入选｜2026 Cannes Film Festival · Directors' Fortnight (world premiere)
入围｜2026 BFI London Film Festival · First Feature Competition
入围｜2026 Shanghai International Film Festival · Asian New Talent
入选｜2026 8th Hainan Island International Film Festival · Asian Horizon
9-temples-to-heaven-2026.contentNote: Public story information includes illness and death predictions, family arguments. Detailed depiction and audiovisual intensity await verification.

py26-001.title: Echoes of Fei Mu
py26-001.syn: Focusing on the artistic career and life of FEI Mu, one of China's most celebrated directors of the 1930s and 1940s, the documentary brings together the perspectives of filmmakers, scholars, family members and friends to offer an intimate glimpse into the inner world of this poet-director.
honors: Official Selection | 2026 10th Pingyao International Film Festival · Pingyao 10 Years (Tributes)
py26-001.contentNote: Public synopsis describes a documentary portrait of director Fei Mu through interviews, with no prominent sensitive themes noted; audiovisual intensity awaits verification.
py26-001.editorial: Listen for the points on which family memories and critical readings diverge.
py26-001.bio: Pan Yilin's documentary revisits Fei Mu through the testimony of filmmakers, scholars and relatives.
py26-001.st: Pair the interviews with the restored Spring in a Small Town. One preserves the work itself, while the other traces how the director's reputation and films have been remembered.
highlights: A tribute documentary pairing with the 4K opening screening of Spring in a Small Town, approaching Fei Mu’s inner world through filmmakers, scholars, and family.

py26-002.title: General della Rovere
py26-002.syn: Forced by the Nazis to impersonate General della Rovere, a dead Italian resistance leader, a small-time swindler is placed among resistance prisoner to gather information. Wrestling with his conscience for the first time, he gradually loses himself in the role he has been forced to play.
honors: Winner | 1959 20th Venice International Film Festival · Golden Lion
Official Selection | 2026 10th Pingyao International Film Festival · Pingyao 10 Years (Tributes)
Nominee | 1962 Academy Awards · Writing (Original Screenplay)
warnings: Nazi occupation and threat of execution
py26-002.contentNote: Public synopsis involves WWII Nazi occupation, prisoner detention, and moral crisis under coercion; visual and audiovisual intensity awaits verification.
py26-002.editorial: Watch how De Sica's character behaves differently with the guards and the prisoners.
py26-002.bio: Roberto Rossellini helped establish Italian neorealism with Rome, Open City and Paisan. He returned to wartime Italy with this drama.
py26-002.st: Based on a story by Indro Montanelli, the film uses Vittorio De Sica's performance to turn an impersonation into a moral test. It shared the Venice Golden Lion with Mario Monicelli's The Great War.
highlights: Screened in tribute to Roberto Rossellini for Pingyao’s tenth anniversary, tracing how a petty swindler becomes the resistance hero he was forced to impersonate.

py26-003.title: A Joke
py26-003.syn: For Xiao Mei and Xiao Shuai, the marriage bed becomes a battleground. Both bring everything they have learned to the game of love, and as the emotional tug-of-war unfolds, they come to understand themselves a little better.
honors: Winner | 2026 10th Pingyao International Film Festival · Fei Mu Award for Best Actress (Sun Yi)
Competition | 2026 10th Pingyao International Film Festival · Hidden Dragons
py26-003.contentNote: Public synopsis centers on emotional confrontation and power struggles within a marriage; specific depictions and audiovisual intensity await verification.
py26-003.editorial: Notice when a joke still unites the couple and when it starts to isolate them.
py26-003.bio: Wang Xiaozhen directed and co-wrote this feature, added to Pingyao's Hidden Dragons selection shortly before the festival.
py26-003.st: The reversal of who makes or accepts a joke gives the relationship its shifting balance of power. Sun Yi received the Fei Mu Award for Best Actress.
highlights: Winner of the Fei Mu Award for Best Actress at Pingyao, turning the marriage bed into an arena of sharp emotional sparring and self-reckoning.

py26-004.title: Gemstones
py26-004.syn: Machado, a Colombian living in France, is hired to return to his hometown of Medellín and steal an emerald. During the risky execution of his plan, he becomes entangled in a series of events that lead him to reconsider the ultimate goal of his mission.
honors: Competition | 2026 10th Pingyao International Film Festival · Crouching Tigers
Official Selection | 2026 Berlinale · Forum
py26-004.contentNote: Public synopsis follows a risky emerald heist in Medellin and unexpected complications; visual intensity awaits verification.
py26-004.editorial: Follow what the camera continues to notice after the original plan goes wrong.
py26-004.bio: Colombian director Simón Vélez made several shorts before his Berlinale Forum feature debut.
py26-004.st: Paulo Carneiro co-produced and wrote the film, shot by Mauricio Reyes and Liberman Arango. The emerald heist supplies momentum while the camera lingers on Medellín beyond the job.
highlights: A taut 70-minute Medellin heist in Crouching Tigers where a hired emerald theft unravels into a quiet reckoning with home and purpose.

py26-005.title: The Rossellinis
py26-005.syn: From the grandson’s perspective, Alessandro Rossellini explores his legendary grandfather Roberto Rossellini and the extraordinary family legacy shaped by cinema, fame and complicated relationships.
honors: Official Selection | 2026 10th Pingyao International Film Festival · Pingyao 10 Years (Tributes)
Official Selection | 2020 Venice Critics’ Week · Closing Film
Official Selection | 2021 Taipei Golden Horse Film Festival
py26-005.contentNote: Public synopsis describes a personal documentary examining the Rossellini family’s complicated relationships and cinematic legacy; audiovisual intensity awaits verification.
py26-005.editorial: See it with General Della Rovere to distinguish public reputation from what a family remembers.
py26-005.bio: Alessandro Rossellini, Roberto Rossellini's grandson, worked in photography before making this documentary.
py26-005.st: It closed Venice Critics' Week in 2020. An interview can put the filmmaker under the same pressure as his relatives as they confront what it means to inherit a famous name.
highlights: Grandson Alessandro Rossellini turns the camera on his own storied clan, offering an intimate companion piece to General della Rovere.

py26-006.title: Bo Bo
py26-006.syn: This is a story about the challenging journey of building a real family —a journey that fate generously rewarded by giving them a “special child.”
honors: Competition | 2026 10th Pingyao International Film Festival · Crouching Tigers
py26-006.contentNote: Public synopsis centers on the difficult journey of building a family and raising a child with special needs; emotional and audiovisual intensity awaits verification.
py26-006.editorial: The girl's wish to sing in a choir gives her a goal of her own as adults decide what should happen to her.
py26-006.bio: Anastasia Kuzina trained in documentary and directing in Russia. Bo Bo is her feature debut after a series of shorts.
py26-006.st: Kuzina wrote the film, Alexander Prosyanov produced it, and Innokenty Smirnov shot it. Spirit of Fire listed a work-in-progress presentation.
highlights: A Crouching Tigers debut from Russia looking closely at the fragile, demanding work of becoming a real family.

py26-007.title: Phony Phoenixes
py26-007.syn: FAN Ruhua, a beautiful young widow, poses as a wealthy man’s daughter to look for a husband. She crosses paths with YANG Xiaomao, a barber who pretends to be a businessman seeking a wife. Unaware of each other’s true identities, the two push forward with their wedding plans out of self‑interest, triggering a string of comic mishaps.
honors: Official Selection | 2026 10th Pingyao International Film Festival · Pingyao 10 Years (Memorial)
py26-007.contentNote: Public synopsis describes a 1947 satirical romantic comedy built around mutual mistaken identities in marriage schemes; audiovisual intensity awaits verification.
py26-007.editorial: Watch the gap between how the two leads wish to appear and what they reveal to each other.
py26-007.bio: Huang Zuolin worked across Shanghai theatre and cinema, bringing stage timing and ensemble performance into film comedies.
py26-007.st: Sang Hu's script places two impostors in the same courtship. Their costumes and manners reflect postwar Shanghai's economic and social aspirations.
highlights: Huang Zuolin’s 1947 Wenhua classic in its 2017 4K restoration, where two impostors court each other in a sparkling satire of postwar Shanghai.

py26-008.title: Replica
py26-008.syn: In modern China, three women form intimate relationships with AI companions. As these virtual bonds begin to mirror their deepest emotional needs, they are confronted with what love means, and what remains missing.
honors: Competition | 2026 10th Pingyao International Film Festival · Hidden Dragons
Winner | 2026 Thessaloniki Documentary Festival · Silver Alexander, Newcomers
Special Mention | 2026 DOXA Documentary Film Festival · Nigel Moore Award
py26-008.contentNote: Public synopsis follows three women in contemporary China forming intimate bonds with AI companions and confronting emotional absence; audiovisual intensity awaits verification.
py26-008.editorial: Consider what each of the three participants wants from her AI companion that she cannot easily ask for elsewhere.
py26-008.bio: Documentary director Chouwa Liang also worked on the editing and sound of Replica.
py26-008.st: The producers include Elda Productions and Axel Rise Films. The film won the Silver Alexander in the Thessaloniki documentary festival's newcomers competition.
highlights: A Hidden Dragons selection examining three women’s relationships with AI companions, using virtual intimacy to reflect real-world longing.

py26-009.title: Memoria
py26-009.syn: From the extraordinary mind of Palme d'Or-winning director Apichatpong WEERASETHAKUL, and starring Academy Award winner Tilda SWINTON, comes a bewildering drama about a Scottish woman, who after hearing a loud 'bang' at daybreak, begins experiencing a mysterious sensory syndrome while traversing the jungles of Colombia.
honors: Winner | 2021 74th Cannes Film Festival · Jury Prize
Official Selection | 2026 10th Pingyao International Film Festival · Pingyao 10 Years (Memorial)
py26-009.contentNote: Public synopsis revolves around a woman haunted by a sudden loud bang at daybreak; sound design features abrupt percussive noise. Sound-sensitive viewers should take note.
py26-009.editorial: Start with the silence before the first sound and notice what changes each time it is described or recreated.
py26-009.bio: Thai filmmaker and artist Apichatpong Weerasethakul brings memory and bodily sensation into daily life, from Tropical Malady to Palme d'Or winner Uncle Boonmee.
py26-009.st: Tilda Swinton plays Jessica, and Sayombhu Mukdeeprom is the cinematographer. The Cannes Jury Prize winner was exhibited at Pingyao in remembrance of producer Simon Field.
highlights: A Pingyao 10 Years memorial screening of Apichatpong Weerasethakul and Tilda Swinton’s hypnotic collaboration, crafted for theatrical acoustics.

py26-010.title: Against Nature
py26-010.syn: After years away, Jonás returns to his hometown to work as a stonemason. There, an intangible force that permeates the landscape, bodies, and time itself leads him toward a destiny shaped by nature and the human condition.
honors: Competition | 2026 10th Pingyao International Film Festival · Crouching Tigers
Official Selection | 2026 Karlovy Vary International Film Festival
py26-010.contentNote: Public synopsis follows a man returning home to work as a stonemason amid natural and existential forces, with no explicit trauma noted; visual intensity awaits verification.
py26-010.editorial: Watch the stonemason's labour and listen to how physical effort changes the rhythm of the landscape.
py26-010.bio: Against Nature is Mexican director Axel Bertha's feature debut.
py26-010.st: Bertha and Fernanda de la Peza produced the film, which premiered at Karlovy Vary. Sparse dialogue leaves rhythm, location and sound to convey much of the story.
highlights: Axel Bertha’s Crouching Tigers entry from Mexico, meditating on stone, landscape, body, and the unseen pull of fate.

py26-011.title: Flies
py26-011.syn: When Olga has to rent out a room in her apartment to a father, she forms an unlikely bond with his nine-year-old son, and unexpectedly, their lives become intertwined.
honors: Official Selection | 2026 10th Pingyao International Film Festival · Galas
Competition | 2026 Berlinale · Main Competition
py26-011.contentNote: Public synopsis depicts financial pressure and an unexpected bond formed between a landlady and a tenant’s nine-year-old son; audiovisual intensity awaits verification.
py26-011.editorial: Look for the small change in a routine that signals someone has begun to count on another person.
py26-011.bio: Fernando Eimbcke's films include Duck Season and Lake Tahoe. He often observes changing relationships through ordinary routines in limited spaces.
py26-011.st: Eimbcke and Vanesa Garnica wrote this black-and-white Berlin competition film. Renting a room sets the story in motion, with framing and distance tracking the relationship that follows.
highlights: Fernando Eimbcke returns in Pingyao’s Galas section with an understated apartment chamber piece about three strangers slowly entering one another’s lives.

py26-012.title: Aces Go Places
py26-012.syn: Bandit King Kong robs a batch of diamonds from a gang and leaves them with a friend. Shortly after hiding the diamonds in a secret spot, the friend is seized by the villain Madman, never to be heard from again. The gang dispatches White Glove to hunt for the diamonds. The police recruit Detective Baldy from the US to work on the case with Superintendent HO.
honors: Official Selection | 2026 10th Pingyao International Film Festival · Pingyao 10 Years (Memorial)
py26-012.contentNote: Public synopsis features a diamond heist, gang pursuit, and slapstick police action typical of 1980s Hong Kong comedy; audiovisual intensity awaits verification.
py26-012.editorial: Pay attention to how the action and verbal comedy keep setting up each other's punchlines.
py26-012.bio: Eric Tsang entered Hong Kong cinema through stunt work and became a director, actor and producer at the centre of popular comedies.
py26-012.st: Raymond Wong wrote this Cinema City hit, which gathers action stunts, gadgetry and Cantonese wordplay into one caper.
highlights: Cinema City’s 1982 Hong Kong action-comedy phenomenon returns for Pingyao 10 Years, pairing thief King Kong with Detective Baldy in breathless set pieces.

py26-013.title: Late Fame
py26-013.syn: Ed Saxberger, a forgotten New York poet who works at the post office, is suddenly rediscovered by a group of twentysomething admirers who hail him as an overlooked genius. Intoxicated by their attention, he gradually begins to question the authenticity of his newfound literary circle.
honors: Official Selection | 2026 10th Pingyao International Film Festival · Galas
Competition | 2025 Venice International Film Festival · Orizzonti
py26-013.contentNote: Public synopsis follows a forgotten New York poet questioning the sincerity of young admirers who rediscover his work; audiovisual intensity awaits verification.
py26-013.editorial: Notice how specific the admirers are when they praise the poem, and how much Ed needs to believe them.
py26-013.bio: Kent Jones worked as a critic and festival programmer, co-directed documentaries, and made the narrative feature Diane.
py26-013.st: Samy Burch adapts Arthur Schnitzler's story for New York. Willem Dafoe, Greta Lee and Edmund Donovan star, with cinematography by Wyatt Garfield.
highlights: Kent Jones’s dryly observant New York literary comedy in Galas, weighing late-life acclaim against the slippery sincerity of young fandom.

py26-014.title: Start from Pingyao Corner: Dong Jie — Break × Zoom In, Zoom Out
py26-014.o: Start from Pingyao Corner: Dong Jie — Break × Zoom In, Zoom Out
py26-014.syn: "BREAK"(SHORT) : Teacher Sheng's monotonous life is interrupted by the filming of a documentary. Can they find what they are trying to find during the short vacation? "ZOOM IN, ZOOM OUT": On a journey to uncover the truth about the death of a roommate he had lost touch with, Shi Zi’an finds himself where the real and online worlds overlap, trying to break through the indifference and emptiness, and to recover some of hope of acting at all.
honors: Official Selection | 2026 10th Pingyao International Film Festival · Pingyao 10 Years (Start from Pingyao Corner)
warnings: Investigation into a friend’s death and online alienation
py26-014.contentNote: Double bill pairing short Break with feature Zoom In, Zoom Out, which involves investigating an estranged roommate’s death and social alienation; audiovisual intensity awaits verification.
py26-014.editorial: Compare who controls the record in the short and who controls the viewpoint in the feature's game.
py26-014.bio: Dong Jie graduated from Beijing Film Academy and edited films before directing his first feature.
py26-014.st:
Break screened at Pingyao Corner in 2019. The team built a working game for Zoom In, Zoom Out, which premiered at Venice Critics' Week.

Break | Beijing Film Academy graduation screening in June 2019, followed by Pingyao Corner the same year. Featuring Dong Jie, with sound direction by Guo Jingxi.

Zoom In, Zoom Out | September 2026 · Venice Critics’ Week (world premiere). Cinematography by Li Zhong and editing by Qin Yanan. Ratings: IMDb 6.7/10, Letterboxd 3.22/5.
highlights: A Pingyao 10 Years double bill pairing Dong Jie’s 2019 student short Break with his 2026 award-winning feature Zoom In, Zoom Out.

py26-015.title: The Days Off
py26-015.syn: As a solar eclipse approaches, 12-year-old Bego struggles to find her place within her family and among her peers. An online friend introduces her to "shifting," a practice through which teens believe they can enter other realities through lucid dreaming.
honors: Competition | 2026 10th Pingyao International Film Festival · Crouching Tigers
Special Mention | 2026 Locarno Film Festival · Filmmakers of the Present
py26-015.contentNote: Public synopsis centers on a 12-year-old girl navigating family and peer pressure through lucid-dreaming “shifting” practices; audiovisual intensity awaits verification.
py26-015.editorial: Follow how Bego balances the pull of her online friendship with her place in her family.
py26-015.bio: Argentine director and editor Lucila Mariani attended the Locarno Filmmakers Academy. The Days Off is her first feature.
py26-015.st: The project passed through La Fabrique Cinéma and received a special mention in Locarno's Filmmakers of the Present competition.
highlights: Set under an approaching solar eclipse, this Crouching Tigers coming-of-age film uses teen “shifting” lore to map a 12-year-old’s search for belonging.

py26-016.title: Torino Shadow
py26-016.syn: A woman travels from southern China to Turin, Italy, to see her husband. But an unexpected departure leaves her to find herself again – and to find cinema.
honors: Official Selection | 2026 79th Cannes Film Festival · Cannes Classics (World Premiere)
Official Selection | 2026 10th Pingyao International Film Festival · Fenjiu Mid-Autumn Night Special Presentation (Asian Premiere)
py26-016.contentNote: Public synopsis describes a 32-minute short about a woman from southern China visiting Turin and rediscovering herself and cinema; no sensitive triggers noted. Screened at the Sept 25 Fenjiu Mid-Autumn Night event with Wutiaoren.
py26-016.editorial: Watch Zhao Tao shift from a visitor on an errand to someone actively looking at the city.

screeningNotes.9/25|19:00|py-palace|platform: Fenjiu Mid-Autumn Night Special Presentation (Asian Premiere) · Post-screening Q&A with Jia Zhang-Ke, Zhao Tao, Mao Tao, Ren Ke & Carlo Chatrian, followed by Wutiaoren live concert (19:00–21:30)

py26-016.bio: Jia Zhangke charts social change through everyday movement and popular culture, often working with Zhao Tao and Yu Lik-wai.
py26-016.st: The National Museum of Cinema in Turin commissioned the short. It showed in Cannes Classics before its Asian premiere at Pingyao's open-air Mid-Autumn screening.
highlights: Jia Zhangke’s 32-minute short starring Zhao Tao alongside Wutiaoren’s Ren Ke and Mao Tao, having its Asian premiere at Pingyao’s Sept 25 open-air Mid-Autumn Night.

py26-017.title: Start from Pingyao Corner: Geng Zihan — The Ray of Sunshine × A Song Sung Blue
py26-017.o: Start from Pingyao Corner: Geng Zihan — The Ray of Sunshine × A Song Sung Blue
py26-017.syn: "THE RAY OF SUNSHINE"(SHORT) : Tomorrow is coming, while we are still stuck at this time. "A SONG SUNG BLUE": During the loneliest of summers, 15 - year - old Liu Xian meets Jin Mingmei, a Korean -Chinese girl. Mingmei’s exuberant youthful vigor leads LIU Xian to experience a new world.
honors: Official Selection | 2026 10th Pingyao International Film Festival · Pingyao 10 Years (Start from Pingyao Corner)
py26-017.contentNote: Double bill pairing short The Ray of Sunshine with coming-of-age feature A Song Sung Blue, touching on adolescent loneliness and emotional upheaval; audiovisual intensity awaits verification.
py26-017.editorial: Compare how the younger characters make room for themselves at home and in public spaces.
py26-017.bio: Geng Zihan made The Ray of Sunshine before her feature debut, A Song Sung Blue, screened in Cannes Directors' Fortnight.
py26-017.st:
The double bill pairs an early Pingyao Corner short with a later feature about two teenage girls, written by Liu Yining.

The Ray of Sunshine | 2019 FIRST International Film Festival and Pingyao Corner (documented screenings). Geng Zihan also produced and edited the short, with cinematography by Hao Jiayue, production design by Lin Yuhan and sound effects by Sun Mingjun.

A Song Sung Blue | 23 May 2023 · Cannes Directors’ Fortnight (world premiere). Shot by Hao Jiayue, with Liang Jing and Liang Long as Liu Xian's parents. Ratings: Rotten Tomatoes critics 60%.
highlights: A Pingyao 10 Years double bill connecting Geng Zihan’s 2019 short The Ray of Sunshine with her Cannes Directors’ Fortnight feature A Song Sung Blue.

py26-018.title: Suzhou Quartet
py26-018.syn: During the rainy season in an ancient water town south of the Yangtze River, four people each carry unspoken burdens, their minds trapped in the past. One stormy night, they chance upon each other at a small noodle shop — and realise they are old friends who have been apart for years.
honors: Winner | 2026 10th Pingyao International Film Festival · Fei Mu Award Special Mention
Competition | 2026 10th Pingyao International Film Festival · Hidden Dragons
Special Mention | 2026 Pingyao · Fei Mu Awards
Competition | 2026 Warsaw Film Festival · International Competition
py26-018.contentNote: Public synopsis follows four estranged acquaintances meeting by chance at a rainy-night noodle shop in a Jiangnan water town; audiovisual intensity awaits verification.
py26-018.editorial: Let sound guide your eye across the four frames. Notice which locations and gestures come back in a different panel.
py26-018.bio: Cai Chengjie won Rotterdam's Tiger Award for The Widowed Witch. Suzhou Quartet takes his interest in local lives into a four-screen structure.
py26-018.st: Inspired by folding screens, Cai and the crew place four vertical images side by side. Huang Bo produces and appears, and Zhang Jiang is the cinematographer.
highlights: Fei Mu Special Mention winner by Cai Chengjie, gathering four burdened old acquaintances inside a small water-town noodle shop on a stormy night.

py26-019.title: Promised Spaces
py26-019.syn: Sleepless from the heat, Sokun leaves his crowded construction dormitory and joins a community of fellow workers living in one of many unfinished high-rises. One such tower becomes the long-awaited luxury home for its first tenant, Seda, who soon feels isolated in the vast gated complex.
honors: Competition | 2026 10th Pingyao International Film Festival · Crouching Tigers
Official Selection | 2026 ACID Cannes
py26-019.contentNote: Public synopsis contrasts construction workers living in unfinished high-rises with an isolated first resident of a gated luxury tower; audiovisual intensity awaits verification.
py26-019.editorial: Notice how the same stairs, walls and lights serve the workers and the first tenant differently.
py26-019.bio: Belgrade-born Berlin-based filmmaker and cinematographer Ivan Marković made his second feature with Cambodian company Anti-Archive among its producers.
py26-019.st: The hybrid film contrasts construction workers and residents, using architecture as a lived expression of class. It premiered in the ACID parallel programme at Cannes.
highlights: Ivan Markovic turns Phnom Penh’s unfinished high-rises into an architectural study of heat, sleepless labor, and luxury-tower solitude.

py26-020.title: Start from Pingyao Corner: Kong Dashan — Goodbye, Mr. Kong × Journey to the West
py26-020.o: Start from Pingyao Corner: Kong Dashan — Goodbye, Mr. Kong × Journey to the West
py26-020.syn: "GOODBYE, MR. KONG"(SHORT) : After teaching for thirty years, Mr. Kong plans to retire early after his son starts a family and has a child in Beijing. On his final day, he returns to the school to say goodbye to everything familiar. "JOURNEY TO THE WEST": A down-and-out science fiction magazine editor receives a mysterious signal that may have come from deep space. He decides to set out with a group of companions in search of aliens—and of an answer.
honors: Official Selection | 2026 10th Pingyao International Film Festival · Pingyao 10 Years (Start from Pingyao Corner)
py26-020.contentNote: Double bill pairing short Goodbye, Mr. Kong with sci-fi road comedy Journey to the West, blending dry humor with gentle melancholy; audiovisual intensity awaits verification.
py26-020.editorial: Compare the teacher's last day at school with the science-fiction editor's attachment to his vocation.
py26-020.bio: Kong Dashan moved from short films to the mockumentary Journey to the West, his first feature.
py26-020.st:
The feature was written with Wang Yitong and won the Fei Mu Award for Best Film at the fifth Pingyao festival. The short screened in the first Pingyao Corner.

Goodbye, Mr. Kong | 2017 Pingyao Corner (documented screening). Written and directed by Kong Dashan, starring Kong Fangang and shot by Sun Xiaochen.

Journey to the West | October 2021 · Pingyao Hidden Dragons. Shot by Matthias Delvaux, with Jiang Qiming and Sheng Chenchen also appearing. Ratings: Douban 8/10, IMDb 7.2/10.
highlights: Pairing Kong Dashan’s 2017 farewell-to-school short with his beloved Pingyao breakout Journey to the West for the festival’s tenth anniversary.

py26-021.title: Forest High
py26-021.syn: In the northern Alps, Anne, Hélène and Suzanne take turns tending a mountain hut. Through the seasons, hikers come and go. Stories bloom and fade, leaving each of them facing the silence.
honors: Competition | 2026 10th Pingyao International Film Festival · Crouching Tigers
Special Mention | 2026 Berlinale · Perspectives
py26-021.contentNote: Public synopsis follows three women taking turns tending an Alpine mountain hut across changing seasons, with no explicit distressing themes noted; audiovisual intensity awaits verification.
py26-021.editorial: Pay attention to what changes as the caretakers and the seasons change at the same lodge.
py26-021.bio: Belgian filmmaker Manon Coubia made shorts and medium-length works before this feature debut.
py26-021.st: Coubia wrote and directed, and Robin Fresson shot the film. It premiered in Berlin's Perspectives section and received a special mention.
highlights: Three women rotate as caretakers of an Alpine refuge across four seasons, letting passing hikers’ fragments fade into mountain quiet.

py26-022.title: Hope
py26-022.syn: In Hope Harbor, a remote village near the Demilitarized Zone, police outpost chief Bum-seok receives alarming news from locals that a tiger has appeared. As the village erupts into panic, Bum-seok is forced to confront a reality beyond belief.
honors: Official Selection | 2026 10th Pingyao International Film Festival · Galas
Competition | 2026 Cannes Film Festival · Main Competition
py26-022.contentNote: Public synopsis describes village-wide panic near the DMZ sparked by sightings of a tiger and an escalating, uncanny threat; specific violent or audiovisual intensity awaits verification.
py26-022.editorial: Watch how two groups respond to the same threat with very different information.
py26-022.bio: Na Hong-jin directed The Chaser, The Yellow Sea and The Wailing before this science-fiction feature.
py26-022.st: Cinematographer Hong Kyung-pyo returns, with a score by Michael Abels and motion-capture work by international cast members. Cannes and Pingyao list different running times.
highlights: Na Hong-jin’s long-awaited 156-minute thriller in Pingyao Galas, escalating from rumors of a tiger near the DMZ into something far beyond expectation.

py26-023.title: A Better Jianghu
py26-023.syn: During the Song dynasty, Qin Hui established the Tiqi (mounted secret guards) to suppress the rebel army. Shen Fang, a civil official, killed forty-one people, including the Jin envoys, in a brutal act of vengeance. As a result, he was hunted down by the elite Tiqi forces led by the second commander, Yuan Hanting. But behind Shen Fang’s sudden rise to fame, there lay a hidden story...
honors: Official Selection | 2026 10th Pingyao International Film Festival · Special Presentations
py26-023.contentNote: Public synopsis depicts Song-dynasty political bloodshed, a revenge killing of forty-one people, and relentless pursuit by secret guards; visual intensity awaits verification.
py26-023.editorial: Treat the stories about Shen Fang as competing versions of events as you follow the chase.
py26-023.bio: Liu Wenpu directs this adaptation of a wuxia novel by Xiao Duan.
py26-023.st: Yang Bingjia supervised production and wrote the script with Lu Xun. The film premiered at Pingyao before its streaming release.
highlights: A Song-dynasty wuxia Special Presentation peeling back the hidden motive behind a civil official’s bloody rise to notoriety.

py26-024.title: Start from Pingyao Corner: Wang Erzhuo — Mother Eden × Farewell, My Hometown
py26-024.o: Start from Pingyao Corner: Wang Erzhuo — Mother Eden × Farewell, My Hometown
py26-024.syn: "MOTHER EDEN"(SHORT) : Listen to a mother tell the story of a generation's youth. "FAREWELL, MY HOMETOWN": The aging grandmother in the countryside, the wandering girl adrift in the modern city, and the mother holding fast in the county town. Drawing from the private memories of three generations of women, the film traces a family's spiritual journey across seventy years of social change.
honors: Official Selection | 2026 10th Pingyao International Film Festival · Pingyao 10 Years (Start from Pingyao Corner)
py26-024.contentNote: Double bill pairing short Mother Eden with feature Farewell, My Hometown, tracing three generations of women across seventy years of social change; audiovisual intensity awaits verification.
py26-024.editorial: Notice how places, objects and names ground each woman's decision to stay or leave.
py26-024.bio: Wang Erzhuo, a Central Academy of Drama graduate, expanded a short film's interest in a mother's life into a feature about three generations.
py26-024.st:
Mother Eden screened in Pingyao Corner and is listed in the FIRST archive. Farewell, My Hometown won the New Currents Award at Busan in 2021.

Mother Eden | 2018 FIRST International Film Festival competition (documented screening). Written, directed and edited by Wang Erzhuo, shot by Li Linhan and featuring Yao Wangxi and Wang Hengming.

Farewell, My Hometown | October 2021 · Busan, New Currents. After its Busan New Currents award, the feature received a Fei Mu special mention at the fifth Pingyao festival.
highlights: A Pingyao 10 Years double bill following Wang Erzhuo’s intimate family trilogy of rural grandmother, county-town mother, and city-bound daughter.

py26-025.title: Just Like Weather
py26-025.syn: Chan and Christine marry young, but their relationship is unstable, marked by breakups and reconciliations, as well as uncertainty over emigration to the United States. They re-enact real-life experiences alongside scripted scenes, travel to America, and are interviewed on camera by Fong himself. With jump-cut editing and a non-linear narrative, the film creates an ambiguous, dreamlike atmosphere. One of Fong's most experimental works, the film marks a creative pinnacle in his career and a landmark of the Hong Kong New Wave.
honors: Winner | 1987 6th Hong Kong Film Awards · Best Director (Allen Fong)
Official Selection | 2026 10th Pingyao International Film Festival · Special Presentations (4K Restoration)
Winner | 1987 Hong Kong Film Awards · Best New Performer and Best Film Editing
Official Selection | 2026 New York Film Festival · World Premiere of the 4K Restoration
py26-025.contentNote: Public synopsis follows a young couple navigating marital ups and downs and uncertainty over emigration, blending documentary interviews with fiction; audiovisual intensity awaits verification.
py26-025.editorial: Watch for the next cut after someone says what really happened.
py26-025.bio: Allen Fong, a Hong Kong New Wave filmmaker, directed Father and Son and Ah Ying before this experiment with documentary and fiction.
py26-025.st: Christine Lee and Chan Hung Nin play versions of themselves. Fong interviews them on camera. The 2026 restoration has a separate exhibition history from the original.
highlights: Allen Fong’s landmark 1986 Hong Kong New Wave hybrid in a 2026 4K restoration, blurring real marriage, interviews, and scripted cinema through jump-cut energy.

py26-026.title: Final Payment
py26-026.syn: In a lopsided confrontation, belated kindness brews an irreversible regret.
honors: Winner | 2026 10th Pingyao International Film Festival · Fei Mu Award for Best Film
Winner | 2026 10th Pingyao International Film Festival · Fei Mu Award for Best Actor (Niu Jianrong)
Competition | 2026 10th Pingyao International Film Festival · Hidden Dragons
py26-026.contentNote: Public synopsis describes a lopsided confrontation in which belated kindness leads to irreversible regret; specific depiction and audiovisual intensity await verification.
py26-026.editorial: Look at who can delay a decision, who has to give an assurance, and how leverage shifts each time they negotiate.
py26-026.bio: Shanxi filmmaker Niu Niu previously won awards at Pingyao with Junjun.
py26-026.st: Niu Jianrong stars in this drama about an unpaid balance. It won Pingyao's Fei Mu awards for Best Film and Best Actor.
highlights: Top winner of the 10th Pingyao Festival, taking both Best Film and Best Actor in the Fei Mu Awards with a taut 86-minute drama of unequal confrontation.

py26-027.title: Start from Pingyao Corner: Wei Shujun — On the Border × Only the River Flows
py26-027.o: Start from Pingyao Corner: Wei Shujun — On the Border × Only the River Flows
py26-027.syn: "ON THE BORDER"(SHORT) : A young Korean‑Chinese boy travels to the city to seek help from his father, as he hopes to go to South Korea. "ONLY THE RIVER FLOWS": A bizarre murder case triggers an undercurrent of destiny. Under the manipulation of fate, police detective MA Zhe gradually falls into absurdity, unease, memories, and moments where reality and fantasy blur. The film is adapted from the pioneering novel by YU Hua.
honors: Official Selection | 2026 10th Pingyao International Film Festival · Pingyao 10 Years (Start from Pingyao Corner)
py26-027.contentNote: Double bill pairing short On the Border with crime drama Only the River Flows, involving murder investigation and psychological unravelling; audiovisual intensity awaits verification.
py26-027.editorial: Compare what the road and the riverbank allow each character to see or know.
py26-027.bio: Wei Shujun moved from Cannes short On the Border to features including Striding into the Wind and Ripples of Life.
py26-027.st:
On the Border received a Cannes short-film special mention. Only the River Flows, co-written with Kang Chunlei, adapts Yu Hua and screened in Un Certain Regard.

On the Border | May 2018 · Cannes Short Film Competition (special mention). Cinematography by Wang Jiehong, featuring Li Zhenming and Cui Yuna. Ratings: IMDb 5.8/10.

Only the River Flows | 20 May 2023 · Cannes Un Certain Regard (premiere). The film's grainy style sits alongside the police unit's temporary base in an old cinema. Ratings: Douban 7.2/10, IMDb 6.6/10, Rotten Tomatoes critics 85%, Metacritic 70/100.
highlights: A Pingyao 10 Years double bill pairing Wei Shujun’s 2018 short On the Border with his Yu Hua adaptation Only the River Flows.

py26-028.title: Yesterday the Eye Didn't Sleep
py26-028.c: Belgium / Lebanon / Palestine / Qatar / Saudi Arabia
py26-028.syn: In a valley veiled by fog and tribal codes, two sisters walk into the night not as daughters, but as offerings — where blood, memory, and silence attempt to keep the fire from spreading.
honors: Winner | 2026 10th Pingyao International Film Festival · Roberto Rossellini Award Special Mention
Winner | 2026 10th Pingyao International Film Festival · NETPAC Award for Best First Feature
Competition | 2026 10th Pingyao International Film Festival · Crouching Tigers
Competition | 2026 Cannes Film Festival · Un Certain Regard
warnings: Tribal blood feud and sacrifice of daughters
py26-028.contentNote: Public synopsis depicts two sisters offered as sacrifices under tribal codes to halt a cycle of vengeance; specific depictions and audiovisual intensity await verification.
py26-028.editorial: Follow the moment the search for a missing woman crosses with the decisions taken for the two sisters.
py26-028.bio: Palestinian filmmaker Rakan Mayasi made several shorts, including Bonboné, before this feature debut.
py26-028.st: Shot in the Bekaa Valley with non-professional performers, the film premiered in Cannes Un Certain Regard. Pôl Seif is the cinematographer.
highlights: Double winner at Pingyao (Rossellini Special Mention and NETPAC Best First Feature), confronting tribal codes and inherited vengeance inside a mist-veiled valley.

py26-029.title: Paper Tiger
py26-029.syn: Two brothers pursue the American Dream but get entangled in a dangerous Russian mafia scheme that terrorizes their family, testing their bond as betrayal becomes possible.
honors: Official Selection | 2026 10th Pingyao International Film Festival · Galas
Competition | 2026 Cannes Film Festival · Main Competition
Official Selection | 2026 New York Film Festival · Opening Film (North American Premiere)
py26-029.contentNote: Public synopsis follows two brothers entangled in a dangerous mafia scheme that brings violence, threats to their family, and betrayal; audiovisual intensity awaits verification.
py26-029.editorial: Listen to how the brothers speak about an opportunity and how they speak about their family once the risks are clear.
py26-029.bio: James Gray has explored family and migration in Little Odessa, The Yards and The Immigrant. Paper Tiger returns him to 1980s New York.
py26-029.st: Gray wrote and directed. Joaquín Baca-Asay shot the film, Christopher Spelman composed the score and Scott Morris edited. It premiered in Cannes competition.
highlights: James Gray returns to family crime drama in Pingyao’s Galas section, watching brotherhood fracture under mafia intimidation and shattered American Dream hopes.

py26-030.title: The Story of Woo Viet
py26-030.syn: After the Vietnam War, Woo Viet, a young Vietnamese of Chinese descent, escapes to a refugee camp in Hong Kong, where he meets Li Lap Quan for the first time, a social worker with whom he has corresponded but never met. Moved by his plight, Li helps him secure a passport to leave for the United States. While arranging his passport, Woo Viet meets Shum Ching, another refugee adrift in the aftermath of the war. The two fall in love and promise to meet again in America. But during a stopover in the Philippines, Shum Ching and several other young women are tricked into working as dancers at a bar. Woo Viet gives up his passage to America to rescue her. Along the way, he meets Ah Sahm, and the two become sworn brothers, only to find themselves pawns in the hands of their boss, Chung Yan…
honors: Official Selection | 2026 10th Pingyao International Film Festival · Special Presentations / East-West Contribution (4K Restoration)
Winner | 1982 Hong Kong Film Awards · Best Screenplay (Alfred Cheung)
Official Selection | 2026 Venice International Film Festival · Venice Classics (4K restoration)
warnings: Postwar refugee displacement, human trafficking, and underworld violence
py26-030.contentNote: Public synopsis involves post-Vietnam War refugee camps, deception of young women into bar work, and underworld violence; visual intensity awaits verification.
py26-030.editorial: Notice who gets to speak through the letters and what is left out when the characters move on.
py26-030.bio: Hong Kong New Wave filmmaker Ann Hui approaches displacement from several angles in her Vietnam Trilogy, which includes this film and Boat People.
py26-030.st: Alfred Cheung won the first Hong Kong Film Award for Best Screenplay. The 2026 4K restoration travelled to Venice Classics and Pingyao, decades after the original's Hong Kong release.
highlights: Presented in a 2026 4K restoration alongside Jury President Ann Hui’s Pingyao visit, following a refugee’s desperate detour from Hong Kong to Manila.

py26-031.title: Start from Pingyao Corner: Zou Jing — Lili Alone × A Girl Unknown
py26-031.o: Start from Pingyao Corner: Zou Jing — Lili Alone × A Girl Unknown
py26-031.syn: "LILI ALONE"(SHORT) : Lili, a young mother, lives with her gambler husband in a remote part of Sichuan. Lonely and poor, she heads for the city in a bid to earn enough money to save her dying father. "A GIRL UNKNOWN": A girl's turbulent journey unfolds across the changing fortunes of three families and her search for self through three different identities, ultimately leading her to a new beginning through love and self-redemption.
honors: Official Selection | 2026 10th Pingyao International Film Festival · Pingyao 10 Years (Start from Pingyao Corner)
warnings: Poverty, family illness, and identity hardship
py26-031.contentNote: Double bill pairing Cannes Critics’ Week short Lili Alone with feature A Girl Unknown, dealing with poverty, a dying father, and difficult identity struggles; audiovisual intensity awaits verification.
py26-031.editorial: Follow how being addressed by a different name can reshape the relationship between a girl and her family.
py26-031.bio: Zou Jing's short Lili Alone and feature debut A Girl Unknown both screened at Cannes Critics' Week.
py26-031.st:
Lili Alone received the short-film Leitz Cine Discovery Prize. A Girl Unknown received the Critics' Week distribution and FIPRESCI prizes before its selection for Pingyao.

Lili Alone | July 2021 · Cannes Critics’ Week (short-film Leitz Cine Discovery Prize). Written and directed by Zou Jing, shot by Liangzi and featuring Huang Lili, Hu Ling and Yu Shixue. Ratings: IMDb 6.9/10.

A Girl Unknown | May 2026 · Cannes Critics’ Week (world premiere). The feature received both the distribution and FIPRESCI awards in Cannes Critics' Week. Ratings: IMDb 6.9/10, Letterboxd 3.78/5.
highlights: A Pingyao 10 Years double bill connecting Zou Jing’s 2021 short Lili Alone with her 2026 feature A Girl Unknown.

a-good-little-soldier-2026.title: A Good Little Soldier
a-good-little-soldier-2026.syn: Carla has just joined the human resources department of a large insurance company, where she leads an ambitious campaign to rebuild its employer brand. Determined to balance staff wellbeing with business targets, she finds the tightrope under her feet growing narrower until compromise becomes unavoidable.
a-good-little-soldier-2026.bio: Stéphane Brizé was born in Rennes in 1966. He studied electronics, then drama in Paris, and worked as a television technician. Le Bleu des villes won the Michel Ornano Award at the 1999 Directors' Fortnight; Mademoiselle Chambon won the César for Best Adapted Screenplay; A Woman's Life won the FIPRESCI Prize in Venice. The Measure of a Man, At War and Another World form his labour trilogy, and The Measure of a Man won Vincent Lindon Best Actor at Cannes.
a-good-little-soldier-2026.st:
The film had its world premiere in the main competition of the 83rd Venice International Film Festival on 9 September 2026, winning Best Screenplay, and opened in France on 25 November. Like Another World and Out of Season, it premiered in Venice; this time Brizé enters the HR department of a large insurer, where Carla is asked to reshape the company's employer brand.

Produced by Gaumont, it is shot by Antoine Héberlé, edited by Géraldine Mangenot and scored by Bertrand Blessing.
highlights: Best Screenplay in the 83rd Venice competition, written by Brizé with Coralie Amédéo and Olivier Gorce.
Alba Rohrwacher plays HR manager Carla; Vincent Lindon appears in another Brizé film.
After the labour trilogy, the workplace is seen from the white-collar, HR side.
a-good-little-soldier-2026.contentNote: The public synopsis involves workplace pressure and power struggles. Compiled from the synopsis and public information; detailed depiction and sensory intensity have not been verified.
honors: 获奖｜83rd Venice International Film Festival · Best Screenplay, Competition
入选｜2026 Valladolid International Film Festival (SEMINCI)
入选｜2026 8th Hainan Island International Film Festival · World Cinema (China premiere)
a-good-little-soldier-2026.editorial: After the bittersweet right-love-wrong-time romance of Out of Season, Stéphane Brizé returns to his home ground. The director of the labour trilogy (The Measure of a Man, At War, Another World) now concentrates the drama in contemporary office relations, showing from a white-collar point of view how power checks and binds people at work. The film won Best Screenplay in the 2026 Venice competition.

back-to-buenos-aires-2026.title: Back to Buenos Aires
back-to-buenos-aires-2026.syn: Buenos Aires, 2008. After 33 years away, Italian doctor Mariano Guerra returns to Argentina to testify against the former officers who kidnapped, tortured and enslaved him during the military dictatorship. Lodged with other survivors in housing provided by the Ministry of Justice, he meets people who were imprisoned with him and waits for his day in court. Living together, their encounters and the testimony bring unresolved events back to the surface. As a survivor, Mariano carries a weight no verdict can lighten, and the return forces him to face what surviving means.
back-to-buenos-aires-2026.bio: Marco Bechis is an Italian director and screenwriter, born in Santiago de Chile and raised in Argentina. Detained in secret by the military regime in 1977 and then expelled, he settled in Italy. His films, including Garage Olimpo, Hijos and BirdWatchers, return to the memory of Latin American dictatorship and to Indigenous issues.
back-to-buenos-aires-2026.st:
The film premiered in competition at the 83rd Venice International Film Festival on 11 September 2026 and was released in Italy by Fandango on 17 September. Bechis wrote it with Vijaya Bechis Boll; it was shot in Porto Alegre, Brazil (standing in for Buenos Aires), then Turin, in January and February 2026. In 2008, former political prisoners wait in Ministry of Justice housing for the trials and face one another again.

Produced by Fandango, 39Films, Karta Film and 34 Filmes with Rai Cinema; cinematography by Fabrizio La Palombara, editing by Jacopo Quadri and Nicolò Tettamanti.
highlights: In competition at the 83rd Venice festival, set during Argentina's 2008 trials for dictatorship-era crimes.
Adriano Giannini plays Mariano, an Italian doctor returning after 33 years to testify.
Porto Alegre stands in for Buenos Aires, with further filming in Turin.
back-to-buenos-aires-2026.contentNote: The public synopsis involves kidnapping, torture and enslavement under the military regime, mainly conveyed through testimony and memories. Compiled from the synopsis and public information; detailed depiction and sensory intensity have not been verified.
honors: 入围｜83rd Venice International Film Festival · Competition
入选｜2026 Busan International Film Festival
入选｜2026 8th Hainan Island International Film Festival · World Cinema (China premiere)
back-to-buenos-aires-2026.editorial: If last year's The Secret Agent by Kleber Mendonça Filho built a striking archive of the past from everyday, unheroic details, Marco Bechis's Back to Buenos Aires works as a counterpoint: a political thriller about Latin America under the 1970s military dictatorship that questions what transitional justice means for survivors.

one-minute-to-midnight-2026.title: One Minute to Midnight
one-minute-to-midnight-2026.syn: Léo, 49, lives with his partner in eastern France. As they are about to separate, he learns that the biological father he never met has died. Before leaving for Italy to settle the estate, he spends a few days in Paris to take stock. Talking with his activist daughter, people and events from the past resurface, and he begins to question the life he has led, above all his relationships with women.
one-minute-to-midnight-2026.bio: Nicolas Pariser is a French director and screenwriter. His first feature, The Great Game, won the Louis Delluc Prize for a first film; Alice and the Mayor was selected for the Cannes Directors' Fortnight. His films often use long conversations to explore politics, intellectuals and public life.
one-minute-to-midnight-2026.st:
The film was selected for the main competition of the 83rd Venice International Film Festival and then for the official competition of the Namur festival. Written by Pariser alone, it follows Léo through a few days in Paris before he goes to Italy to settle his birth father's estate, talking with his daughter, former partners and friends.

Produced by Bizibi with Dimanche Soir; cinematography by Julia Mingo, music by Benjamin Esdraffo; distribution and sales by Pyramide.
highlights: In competition at the 83rd Venice festival, written and directed by Pariser.
Melvil Poupaud stars, with Chiara Mastroianni, Golshifteh Farahani and Anaïs Demoustier as women in his life.
Built from long conversations over a few days in Paris.
one-minute-to-midnight-2026.contentNote: The public synopsis involves the death of a family member and discussions of sex and power. Compiled from the synopsis and public information; detailed depiction and sensory intensity have not been verified.
honors: 入围｜83rd Venice International Film Festival · Competition
入围｜2026 Namur International Francophone Film Festival · Official Competition
入选｜2026 8th Hainan Island International Film Festival · World Cinema (Asian premiere)
one-minute-to-midnight-2026.editorial: Nicolas Pariser's One Minute to Midnight may be one of the most contemporary films of the year: a privileged white man reflecting on himself in a post-MeToo climate, alert to how Western society now regards sex and power. Its very restrained self-awareness, evasive conversations and Melvil Poupaud's quiet presence keep drama at a distance in favour of a careful gaze, perhaps rooted in an identity-political unease.

variations-on-a-theme-2026.title: Variations on a Theme
variations-on-a-theme-2026.syn: In Namaqualand, South Africa, an elderly goat herder falls for a scam promising long-overdue compensation for her father's service in the Second World War. While she waits for money that will never come, she must face her family's decision to move her to the city and take away the last of her independence.
variations-on-a-theme-2026.bio: Jason Jacobs and Devon Delmar are South African directors and screenwriters who work together. Their co-directed feature Carissa (2024) is also set in a community in the Western Cape. Variations on a Theme is their second feature; Delmar also edited it.
variations-on-a-theme-2026.st:
The film premiered in competition at the 55th International Film Festival Rotterdam in early 2026 and won the Tiger Award, then screened at New Directors/New Films and the London Film Festival. It is the second feature by Jason Jacobs and Devon Delmar after Carissa (2024), cast with non-professionals: Hettie is played by Jacobs's grandmother Hettie Farmer, and Jacobs narrates in Afrikaans as her grandson.

Produced by Kraal, Meria Productions and Interakt; cinematography by Gray Kotze, editing by Delmar.
highlights: Tiger Award, the top prize of the 55th International Film Festival Rotterdam.
Lead Hettie Farmer is co-director Jason Jacobs's grandmother; he narrates as her grandson.
65 minutes of fixed long takes and Afrikaans voice-over, between documentary and fiction.
variations-on-a-theme-2026.contentNote: The public synopsis involves a scam targeting an elderly person, ageing and loss of independence. Compiled from the synopsis and public information; detailed depiction and sensory intensity have not been verified.
honors: 获奖｜55th International Film Festival Rotterdam · Tiger Award
入选｜2026 New Directors/New Films
入选｜2026 BFI London Film Festival
入选｜2026 8th Hainan Island International Film Festival · World Cinema (Chinese mainland premiere)
variations-on-a-theme-2026.editorial: Rotterdam Tiger Award winner Variations on a Theme is also about age and loneliness, and also about melody, here a visual one, repeated and weighty. In silent, contemplative fixed long takes, bodies near the end of life become wordless hills.

style-kaleidoscope.name: Style Kaleidoscope
style-kaleidoscope.blurb: From Bergman’s road memories to Tarkovsky’s apocalyptic prayer, from Fei Mu’s city wall to Tsui Hark’s jianghu, seventeen works spanning 1947 to 2025 share one screen — a map of “style.”

sparrow-tribe-space.name: Sparrow Tribe Film Space
sparrow-tribe-space.blurb: Sparrow Tribe is an independent screening and curating collective, best known over the past decade for its “blind-box screenings.” After four quiet years, it set out again around National Day 2026 with an offline arthouse space of its own: Sparrow Tribe Film Space. We believe an arthouse cinema is part of a city’s cultural infrastructure. This page collects the space’s screening schedule and will be updated as sessions are announced.

german-film-2026.name: 2026 German Film Festival
german-film-2026.blurb: The 2026 Festival of German Cinema in China arrives in Hangzhou from November 14 to 23 at CINEMA CIRCLE (Hangzhou Heng Long), with ten acclaimed titles from the past two years of international festivals. It is co-presented by German Films and the Goethe-Institut China (Beijing), co-organized by Broadway Cinema, and supported by the German Embassy in China.

hainan-2026.name: 2026 Hainan Island International Film Festival
hainan-2026.sub: The 8th Hainan Island International Film Festival
hainan-2026.blurb: December 6–12 in Sanya. The 8th Hainan Island International Film Festival is co-hosted by China Media Group and the Hainan Provincial Government under the theme “Many Wonders of the Sea, Cinema Leading the Future”. The Golden Coconut Awards run feature, documentary and short film competitions, drawing 4,632 submissions from 133 countries and regions this year. Two-time Palme d’Or winner Ruben Östlund presides over the jury, and French actress Audrey Tautou is the festival ambassador. Screenings reach cinemas in Sanya, Haikou and elsewhere, with outdoor venues across the island, and continue on weekends in Sanya and Haikou after the closing. Films and screening times will be added as announced.

tiantan-tour-2026.name: 2026 BJIFF Tour
tiantan-tour-2026.sub: Tiantan Image · International Films National Tour
tiantan-tour-2026.blurb:
The BJIFF tour brings together eight films about growing up, parting and women’s experiences. Through everyday details, they look closely at how people relate to one another.

Hangzhou
MixC Cinema (Yaao MixC Tiandi), Dolby Cinema 4K Laser hall

wutianming-2026.name: 2026 Wu Tianming Young Film Festival
wutianming-2026.sub: Opening & Tributes · French Realism · Star Screenings · Beyond the First Feature (industry)
wutianming-2026.blurb:
Eight masterworks of French realism in three sections: Masters' Debut, Mirrors of the Era and Cinema Today. They run from Malle's prelude to the New Wave, through the social realism of Kassovitz, the Dardennes and Doillon, to the present-day echoes of Haneke, Ladj Ly, Triet and Farhadi. On screen, yesterday is never far. The films screen in Jiaxing and Hangzhou.

Star Screenings | Four free screenings in Jiaxing: Hideaway: The Dossiers, Never Too Late, 24 Flavors and Red River, each with a post-screening discussion of approximately 30 minutes. Guest and venue details, together with the individual WeChat Mini Program registration code, are on each film page.

pingyao-2026.name: 2026 Pingyao International Film Festival
pingyao-2026.blurb: September 24–30 at Pingyao Film Palace, Shanxi. Under the 10th-edition theme “Keep Walking,” PYIFF presents five official sections—Hidden Dragons, Crouching Tigers, Galas, Special Presentations, and Pingyao 10 Years—totalling 47 official films and 86 screenings across six halls. Opened with Fei Mu’s Spring in a Small Town (4K Restoration) on Sep 24, closed with Good Trip, and featured the Asian premiere of Jia Zhang-Ke’s short Torino Shadow (world premiered at Cannes 2026) during Fenjiu Mid-Autumn Night on Sep 25.

ui.专题页按影展、单元归档影片，分「即将放映」和「已结束」；可以看到自己在这个专题看: Programme pages group films by festival and section, split into Upcoming and Ended, and show how many you've watched. Some festivals also list events such as masterclasses and forums, which you can add to your plan.
ui.片目收录全部影片，可以搜片名、导演、演员，按专题、城市、放映版本和「我的」状态（: Films lists everything. Search by title, director or cast, and filter by programme, city, screening format and your own status (want to watch, watched, etc.).
ui.影片页点「☆ 想看」加入想看清单；想看的影片出现新场次时，片目卡片会标「新场次」: Tap ☆ Want to watch on a film page to add it to your watchlist. When a watchlisted film gets new screenings, its card shows New screenings and Me › Watchlist tells you too.
ui.影片页有放映场次、购票码、简介、主创、荣誉（区分获奖、提名、入围）、全球首映、内: Film pages show screenings, ticket QR codes, synopsis, credits, honours (won, nominated or selected), world premiere, content notes and links to rating sites. Cinema releases with many screenings can be filtered by date and cinema.
ui.内容提示根据剧情资料整理，只作观影前参考，不是官方分级，也不代表完整审片。: Content notes are compiled from plot material as a guide only — not an official rating, and not a full review of the film.
ui.影片页、专题页可以生成分享海报（带二维码），或直接分享链接给朋友。: Film and programme pages can make a share poster with a QR code, or share a link with friends.
ui.在影片页点「＋ 看过 · 盖章」，护照里就盖下这部片的印章；每部片的印章形状、角: Tap ＋ Watched · Stamp on a film page to stamp it into your passport. Each film's stamp has its own shape, angle and ink colour.
ui.每部片可打 0–10 分（每颗星 2 分，可半颗）；再点同一个分数清除。分数会印: Rate each film 0–10 (2 points per star, half stars allowed); tap the same score again to clear it. The score is printed on the stamp.
ui.再看一次就点「＋ 再看一次」，每次的日期、场次、放映版本和评分单独记录；点任意一: Seen it again? Tap ＋ Watch again. Each viewing keeps its own date, screening, format and rating; tap a row to edit or delete it. Tap the stamped status to view the stamp in your passport, see this film's collector's tickets, or remove the stamp.
ui.在「我的」点护照封面翻开，左右拖动页角翻页，像翻纸一样；宽屏、平板横屏和折叠屏展: Tap the passport cover in Me to open it and drag a page corner to turn pages like paper. Wide screens, landscape tablets and unfolded foldables show two pages side by side.
ui.资料页点姓名改成自己的名字，点照片框从相册选一张照片；名字是英文字母时，会印在底: On the data page, tap the name to change it and tap the photo box to pick a photo. A name in Latin letters is also printed in the machine-readable lines at the bottom.
ui.资料页汇总看过影片、专题、影院、平均评分、首枚与最近印章和银幕总时长；印章每页最: The data page sums up films watched, programmes, cinemas, average rating, first and latest stamps and total screen time. Stamp pages hold up to 15 stamps each, ordered by viewing date.
ui.每册护照最多 285 枚印章，满了自动换下一册，第 2 册起封面换颜色；在「护照: Each passport volume holds up to 285 stamps; a new volume starts automatically, with a new cover colour from volume 2. Switch volumes on the passport shelf.
ui.「成长」按看过的不同影片数升级（最高 20 级），按奖项、口味、习惯、银幕、重温: Growth levels up with the number of different films watched (up to level 20) and lights badges in seven groups: awards, taste, habits, screens, rewatches, footprints and easter eggs. Cities, countries and continents of your screenings light up under Footprints.
ui.影片页「趣味」一栏给有趣度和无聊度各打 0–5 分（可半颗），和星级评分分开。开: In the taste row on a film page, rate how interesting and how boring it was, 0–5 each (half points allowed), separately from stars. With cloud sync on, new taste ratings count anonymously towards the community average; you can withdraw them in the same panel.
ui.「我的 › 我的电影趣味图谱」把两项都打过分的影片放在四象限里，也可以切换看社区: Me › My film taste map places films rated on both scales in four quadrants; you can switch to the community view.
ui.至少 3 部影片两项都打过分后，可以生成「我的电影趣味图谱」长图：16 种趣味人: Once at least 3 films have both taste ratings, create a long image of your film taste map: 16 taste personalities, a personal title, four dimensions and data insights, by year or programme. It's all computed on your device; nothing is uploaded.
ui.「我的 › 我的典藏票根册」里，每一次观影都可以做成一张典藏票根，按年、月排列。: In Me › My Collector's Ticket Book, every viewing can become a collector's ticket, arranged by year and month. Search by title, director, cinema, programme or serial at the top, and use Filter to pick out tickets checked in on site, with guest autographs, with closed editions and more. Viewings without a ticket are listed under To make, and can all be made in one tap.
ui.每张票根的配色、底箔、纸张和工艺由这次观影决定，同一张永远开出同一个样子；第一次: Each ticket's colours, foil, paper and finishes are set by that viewing, so the same ticket always comes out the same. The first time you open it, it starts on the back and flips to the front. A rare few are a hidden 1/1 edition.
ui.在票根详情页拖动可以 360° 转动票根，烫印、镭射、闪粉和海报上的隐形工艺会随: Drag on the ticket page to turn it 360°; foil, holographic, glitter and hidden finishes on the poster catch the light as it moves. Tap to flip.
ui.票面海报可以换成老电视、胶片放映、VHS、报纸网点等手绘风格，也可以拖动裁切位置: Restyle the ticket's poster as an old TV, film projection, VHS, newspaper halftone and more, or drag to recrop it and save.
ui.背面有一串典藏编号，联网后会烫上「本片第几张典藏」的发行序号；关联了场次时还有「: The back carries a serial number; once online, it's foil-stamped with an issue number — which collector's ticket of this film it is — and, when linked to a screening, its number within that screening. Some time after a film's run ends the edition closes and the total is added.
ui.在影展期间看的票根带「影展限定」章；集齐一个影展专题的全部影片或一个单元，纪念章: Tickets from viewings during a festival carry a festival-limited mark. Collect every film in a festival programme or section and the emblem turns gold as a complete set.
ui.在放映现场扫主办方提供的签到码，会自动盖章、做好这一场的典藏票根，并标上「现场认: Scan the organiser's check-in code at the screening to stamp the film, make this screening's collector's ticket and mark it Checked in on site.
ui.现场认证过的票根，如果这一场的映后嘉宾留下了签名，票面海报上会出现金色签名。: If a post-screening guest signs for that screening, tickets checked in on site show the signature in gold on the poster.
ui.背面的二维码打开验真页，显示这张票根的影片、序号、场次和发行时间，不显示任何个人: The QR code on the back opens a verification page with the ticket's film, numbers, screening and issue time — no personal information.
ui.详情页「导出」生成正反面合成图，也可以只导出正面或背面；票根册可以导出年度、专题: Export on the ticket page makes a front-and-back image, or just the front or back. The ticket book exports ticket walls by year, programme or your own selection.
ui.「我的 › 导出与分享」把个人排片生成带二维码的长图、分享链接、日历文件，或打印: Me › Export & share turns your plan into a long image with a QR code, a share link, a calendar file, or a printed PDF — optionally for one programme only.
ui.个人排片可以「分享给朋友」，对方打开就能看到你的场次并一键加入。: Share your plan with a friend; they can see your screenings and add them in one tap.
ui.打开朋友分享的排片时，会和你的排片对比：同场、同片不同场、可以一起去和时间冲突。: Opening a friend's shared plan compares it with yours: same screenings, same film at other times, screenings you can join, and clashes.
ui.「生成我的影院观影结算」按年份、月份、专题筛选，可以自选封面、统计、本期最爱、印: Create my cinema recap filters by year, month and programme, and lets you pick sections such as cover, stats, favourites and stamp wall for one long image.
ui.「我的 › 我的海报墙」把看过的影片排成海报墙，可按专题、年 / 季 / 月筛选: Me › My poster wall lays out the films you've watched as posters, filterable by programme and year, quarter or month, and exportable with or without ratings.
ui.看过、评分、排片、票根默认只保存在这台设备上；清除浏览器数据或换设备前，请先开启: Watched films, ratings, plans and tickets are stored only on this device by default. Turn on sync or download a backup before clearing browser data or changing devices.
ui.小程序默认用微信身份自动同步看过、评分、排片和票根，换手机登录同一个微信就能找回: The mini program syncs watched films, ratings, plans and tickets with your WeChat identity automatically; log in to the same WeChat on a new phone to get them back. After Stop syncing it won't turn on again by itself.
ui.「个人档案云端同步」会生成一串 SP- 开头的同步码，在另一台设备输入就能同步看: Cloud sync for your profile creates a sync code starting with SP-. Enter it on another device to sync watched films, ratings, photo, holder name, plan and tickets. Keep the code safe — it can't be recovered by name.
ui.网页同步卡片点「用小程序扫码连接」显示二维码，用小程序「扫码连接网站」扫一下，两: On the website's sync card, Connect by scanning in the mini program shows a QR code; scan it with Scan to connect website in the mini program and both merge into one profile.
ui.可以下载一份完整备份（不含同步码），导入时与现有记录合并。: Download a full backup (without the sync code); importing it merges with your existing records.
ui.网站和小程序只做匿名的按天统计（比如页面浏览、加入排片的次数），不记录同步码、评: The website and mini program keep only anonymous daily counts (such as page views and plan additions); no sync codes, ratings, location or WeChat identity are recorded.
ui.「我的 › 外观」可选跟随系统、浅色或暗色。: Me › Appearance lets you match the system, or choose light or dark.
ui.排片、片名、人名有误，或想合作放映、影展，在「我的 › 影展合作&反馈与纠错」联: Spotted a wrong screening, title or name, or want to partner on a screening or festival? Contact us via Me › Festival partnerships & feedback; a screenshot and page name help us fix it faster.
ui.排片、护照、典藏票根、同步，一页看懂: Schedule, passport, tickets and sync on one page
ui.已加一次观影 · 可补日期、版本和评分: Viewing added — set its date, format and rating
ui.盖下第一枚印章，就此入场: Stamp your first film to begin
ui.看过的影片落在哪座城市，这里就会点亮一座城市。: Cities light up here as you stamp films screened in them.
ui.每册最多 285 枚印章，满了自动换下一册。: Each volume holds up to 285 stamps, then a new one begins.
ui.每本护照最多 285 枚印章（20 页），满了自动换下一册；按观影日期从早到晚排: Each passport holds up to 285 stamps (20 pages); when it is full a new volume begins. Stamps run by viewing date, and covers change colour from Volume 2. Open “Passport shelf” under Me to switch volumes once you have more than one.
ui.在「我的」里展开「我的观影护照」，点封面即可翻开；左右滑动或点上一页 / 下一页: Expand “My film passport” under Me and tap the cover. Swipe or use Previous / Next to turn pages. On iPad landscape or an unfolded foldable it opens as a two-page spread, like a real book.
ui.在影片页点「看过」，护照里就会盖下这部片的印章；每部片的印章形状和颜色各不相同，: Tap “Watched” on a film page to stamp it into your passport. Every film gets its own stamp shape and colour; tap a stamp to jump back to the film.
ui.每部片可打 0–10 分（半颗星为 1 分），分数会印在章上；观影日期默认取你已: Rate each film from 0 to 10 (a half star is 1 point); the score is printed on the stamp. The viewing date defaults to a screening in your plan and can be changed to the day you really watched.
ui.护照首页点姓名可以改成自己的名字，也能从相册放一张照片；姓名会同步显示在护照底部: Tap the name on the first page to write your own, and add a photo from your album. Your name also appears in the machine-readable lines at the foot of the page.
ui.资料页汇总看过影片、专题、影院数、平均评分、首枚与最近印章和银幕总时长；印章每页: The data page sums up films seen, programmes, cinemas, average rating, first and latest stamp and total screen time. Each stamp page holds up to 15 stamps, then a new page opens.
ui.在排片表点色块右上角的 + 加入场次；「我的」里会按天列出日程并自动检查时间冲突: Tap + on a block in the timetable to add a show. Me lists your plan by day and checks for time clashes; the timeline can show only your plan and be filtered by programme.
ui.排片页和片目页的筛选都可以多选，比如同时看几天、几家影院或几个专题，更快找到想看: Filters on the timetable and film pages accept several choices at once, such as multiple days, cinemas or programmes, so you can find shows faster.
ui.在「我的」里可以单独打开「已加入排片」和「已看过」两份片单，回顾想看的与看过的。: Open the Planned and Watched lists from Me to review what you want to see and what you have seen.
ui.把排片生成带二维码的长图、分享链接或加入日历（网页版另支持 PDF），发给一起看: Turn your plan into a QR poster, a share link or calendar events (PDF on the web), and send it to friends who watch with you.
ui.护照页底部「生成我的影院观影结算」，可按年份、月份、专题筛选，生成一张印章墙长图: Use “Generate my cinema recap” under the passport. Filter by year, month or programme to get a stamp-wall poster, perfect for year-end or after each festival.
ui.开启上方云端同步，另一台设备用同步码即可带走看过记录、评分、照片和排片。同步码请: Turn on cloud sync above; enter the sync code on another device to bring over watched films, ratings, photo and plan. Keep the code safe: it cannot be recovered from your name.
ui.可以下载一份完整备份（含观影记录、评分、照片、姓名和排片，不含同步码），导入时会: Download a full backup (watched films, ratings, photo, name and plan; no sync code). Importing merges your plan and, for the same film, the backup record wins.
ui.右上角可切换中文 / English；网页版可「添加到手机」放到桌面像 App: Switch between 中文 and English at the top. The web version can be added to your home screen like an app (use Floating Window in WeChat). Report schedule errors under “Feedback & corrections”.
ui.在影片页点「看过」，护照里就会盖下这部片的印章；可以打星评分、改观影日期。: Tap “Watched” on a film page to stamp it into your passport. You can rate it and change the viewing date.
ui.护照首页可以填姓名、从相册放一张照片，印章每页最多 15 枚。: Add your name and a photo from your album on the cover. Each page holds up to 15 stamps.
ui.在排片表点色块右上角的 + 加入场次，「我的」里会自动检查时间冲突；首页甘特图可: Tap + on a block in the timetable to add a show; “Me” checks for clashes. The timetable can show only your plan.
ui.把排片生成带二维码的长图、分享链接或加入日历。: Turn your plan into a QR poster, a share link or calendar events.
ui.护照页底部「生成我的影院观影结算」，可按年份、月份、专题筛选，生成一张印章墙长图: Use “Generate my cinema recap” under the passport. Filter by year, month or programme to get a stamp-wall poster.
ui.开启上方云端同步，另一台设备用同步码即可带走看过记录、评分、照片和排片。: Turn on cloud sync above; enter the sync code on another device to bring over watched films, ratings, photo and plan.
ui.排片和护照保存在当前浏览器；开启上面的云端同步，或用分享链接，即可换设备。: Your plan and passport live in this browser. Turn on cloud sync above, or use a share link, to switch devices.

ui.按专题分组，每个专题可收起；已放映的收进专题内，专题结束后归入「往期专题」。右侧: Grouped by programme; each can be collapsed. Screened films tuck inside it, and ended programmes move to “Past programmes”. Douban score on the right.
ui.订阅后，场次有调整会自动同步到你的日历。: Once subscribed, schedule changes sync to your calendar automatically.
ui.提示仅供参考，不是官方分级；观影前请按个人情况判断。: For reference only, not an official rating; please use your own judgement before viewing.
ui.打开该站搜索结果: Opens search results on that site

ui.当前分类暂无影片: No films in this category yet
ui.在排片表中加入场次，就会出现在这里。: Add a screening to your plan to see it here.
ui.在影片页点「看过」，开始收集你的电影印章。: Mark a film as seen to start collecting stamps.
ui.换个分类，或试试片名、导演、演员。: Try another category, title, director or cast member.
ui.把每一次银幕相遇，收进自己的电影档案。: A personal archive of every encounter with cinema.

ui.按年份与专题，收藏印章与评分。: Collect your stamps and ratings by year and programme.
ui.同步码丢失时可在另一台已连接设备查看。没有同步码和已连接设备时，无法凭姓名找回；: Find a lost code on another connected device. Without the code or a connected device, recovery by name is unavailable; a backup can still restore your local archive.
ui.现有资料未确认特别提示内容。: No specific advisory established from the available material.
ui.请先保存完整备份，并在其他设备停止同步。清空云端内容并断开本设备？本机档案仍会保: First save a full backup and disconnect other devices. Clear cloud content and disconnect this device? Your local archive will stay.
ui.盖章、评分与保存记录: Stamps, ratings and saving your records
ui.提示可能涉及轻微剧透，不是官方分级。: Notes may contain mild spoilers and are not an official classification.
ui.小程序记录保存在本机，个人排片与看过记录也会按微信用户同步。启用同步码后，姓名、: Mini-program records are stored on this device. Plans and watched records also sync under your WeChat user. Enabling a sync code stores a separate full archive, including your name and photo, in Supabase for website and multi-device sync.
ui.导入后会合并排片，同一影片以备份中的记录为准；已开启同步时也会同步到其他设备。继: Import combines planned screenings and replaces the same film's record with the backup copy. With sync enabled, changes also reach other devices. Continue?
ui.停止同步只断开本设备，不删除本机或云端。清空云端内容前，请先在其他设备停止同步，: Disconnecting only stops sync on this device; it deletes neither local nor cloud data. Before clearing cloud content, disconnect other devices to prevent old records being uploaded again. Clearing removes the cloud photo, name, plans and viewing content, while retaining an anonymous sync record and deletion markers. The local copy stays.
ui.排片、印章、评分、姓名和照片默认保存在本浏览器。开启同步后，档案副本会存入 Su: Plans, stamps, ratings, your name and photo are stored in this browser by default. Enabling sync stores a copy in Supabase, accessible on other devices through your sync code. This is not an end-to-end encrypted vault.
ui.请在网页版下载备份: Download your backup on the website
ui.未查到美国MPA分级，不代表全年龄适宜: US MPA rating not established; not an all-ages assurance
ui.云端清空未完成，请稍后重试: Cloud content could not be cleared; please retry later
ui.展开封面与电影印章: Open the cover and your film stamps
ui.闪烁与突发音量尚未核实；有需要请提前询问影院。: Flashing images and sudden sound levels are unverified; ask the cinema in advance if needed.
ui.停止同步只断开本设备。清空同步码对应的云端内容前，请先在其他设备停止同步；本机副: Disconnecting only stops sync on this device. Before clearing the code-linked cloud archive, disconnect other devices. Local records and WeChat-user plans and viewing records remain. Anonymous sync records and deletion markers are retained; contact the maintainer to request full deletion.
ui.带着日程出发，带着电影回来。: Take your programme out. Bring the films home.
